about: Fistral Beach Surf School & Hire works from the International Surfing Centre on Fistral Beach in Newquay and says it is the only surf school and hire based on the beach itself. It teaches all levels from beginners to advanced surfers, runs kids' clubs and weekends, and operates a large hire centre.
offers: Beginner, improver, intermediate and advanced coaching
Kids-only lessons and kids' surf clubs
Hire: wetsuits, bodyboards, surfboards, SUPs and beach kit
where: International Surfing Centre, Fistral Beach, Newquay TR7 1HY, next to a pay-and-display car park
goodToKnow: Lesson equipment is included, with extra thermal kit when it is needed
Coaches are described as qualified surf instructors and lifeguards
Booked online; deposit and cancellation details are in the terms
gaps: No ages for kids' lessons and no what-to-bring list.
